exploreUrl:
<js>
var result = [];
var mainCat = infoMap["频道"] || "分类";

result.push({
    "title": "频道",
    "type": "select",
    "chars": ["分类", "排行", "全本"],
    "default": mainCat,
    "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
    "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}

        ["网游同人", "/class_6/"],
        ["女频频道", "/class_7/"],
        ["其他小说", "/class_8/"]
    ],
    "排行": [
        ["周点击", "/top/weekvisit/"],
        ["月点击", "/top/monthvisit/"],
        ["总点击", "/top/allvisit/"],
        ["日推荐", "/top/dayvote/"],
        ["周推荐", "/top/weekvote/"],
        ["月推荐", "/top/monthvote/"],
        ["总推荐", "/top/allvote/"],
        ["总收藏", "/top/goodnum/"],
        ["总字数", "/top/size/"],
        ["最新入库", "/top/postdate/"]
    ],
    "全本": [
        ["周点击", "/quanben/weekvisit/"],
        ["月点击", "/quanben/monthvisit/"],
        ["总点击", "/quanben/allvisit/"],
        ["日推荐", "/quanben/dayvote/"],
        ["周推荐", "/quanben/weekvote/"],
        ["月推荐", "/quanben/monthvote/"],
        ["总推荐", "/quanben/allvote/"],
        ["总收藏", "/quanben/goodnum/"],
        ["总字数", "/quanben/size/"],
        ["最新入库", "/quanben/postdate/"]
    ]
};

var selected = cats[mainCat];
for (var i = 0; i < selected.length; i++) {
    result.push({
        "title": selected[i][0],
        "url": selected[i][1],
        "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25}
    });
}

JSON.stringify(result);
</js>

searchUrl:
<js>
var keyEnc = java.encodeURI(key);
var html = java.ajax("https://m.zdzn.net/user/search.html?q=" + keyEnc);
var vars = {};
var reg = /var\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/g;
var m;
while((m = reg.exec(html)) !== null){
    vars[m[1]] = m[2];
}
var body = "q=" + keyEnc;
var names = ["vw","abw","ru","jrt","van","fw","cwl","gpr","uyoo","tz","euu","tsn","eju","um","fp","dvm","jpk","deblkx","ht","azy","sna","wqx","fpp","rup","jwj","bgt","qp","yf","cw","wq","sign"];
for(var i=0; i<names.length; i++){
    body += "&" + names[i] + "=" + (vars[names[i]] || "");
}
"https://m.zdzn.net/api/search,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"" + body + "\"}";
</js>
